channel.title: Zudo Works Insights
channel.description: Practical guides on Zoho CRM, Zoho Creator, Deluge and integrations from the Zudo Works team.

item.title: Zoho CRM vs Salesforce for Small and Mid-Size Businesses: Cost, Fit and the 2026 Changes
item.description: Choose Zoho CRM if you want monthly or yearly billing without a contract, processes, custom modules and API access at mid-level editions, and links to other Zoho apps. Choose Salesforce if you need its large app marketplace and admin talent pool, or your group has standardised on it. Compare the editions you would actually need: Salesforce adds API access from Core, and sandboxes start at Zoho CRM Enterprise.
item.dc:creator: Arunkumar V

item.title: Zoho One Implementation Checklist: Licensing, Rollout Order and What Manufacturers Need on Top
item.description: Decide the licensing model first: All Employee Pricing must cover everyone on payroll, Flexible User Pricing covers only chosen users. Then set up Zoho Directory, load data in dependency order and roll out one business area at a time. Manufacturers should note that Zoho ERP is sold separately and is not part of Zoho One.
item.dc:creator: Arunkumar V

item.title: Zoho Creator vs Airtable (and Zoho Tables): Which One Fits Your Business?
item.description: Choose Airtable or its Zoho equivalent, Zoho Tables, when one team needs a flexible shared database. Choose Zoho Creator when the data drives a process with stages and owners, people outside the office or the company must use it, or it has to work directly with Zoho CRM, Books or Inventory. Airtable bills only people who edit; Creator bills every user and adds portals for outsiders.
item.dc:creator: Arunkumar V

item.title: Zoho Inventory vs Katana for Small Manufacturers: Assembly or Real Production?
item.description: Choose Zoho Inventory if production is a single assembly step and your accounts are in Zoho Books; its own knowledge base says it has no manufacturing module. Choose Katana if you run multi-step manufacturing orders, need a shop floor app, plan materials ahead or outsource production. Katana can connect to Zoho CRM through Zoho Flow.
item.dc:creator: Arunkumar V

item.title: Zoho CRM Blueprint: A Step-by-Step Setup Guide, With a Manufacturing Example
item.description: A Zoho CRM Blueprint enforces a process on a picklist field such as Stage: records move only through transitions, and each transition sets who can act, what they must enter and what happens automatically. Blueprint starts in the Professional edition (3 Blueprints); Enterprise allows 50 and Ultimate 100.
item.dc:creator: Arunkumar V

item.title: Zoho ERP vs Odoo for Manufacturers in India: A Fair Comparison
item.description: Choose Zoho ERP if you are in India, your production fits a bill of materials, job card and work center model, and you want finance, GST, payroll and production in one Zoho system. Choose Odoo if planning by work center capacity, maintenance and engineering changes matter most, or you need it outside India.
item.dc:creator: Arunkumar V

item.title: Zoho Books vs TallyPrime: Which Fits a Growing Manufacturer or Trader?
item.description: Stay on TallyPrime if you record production and job work in it and most users sit in one office. Choose Zoho Books if sales, branches or owners need the same live data and you want it linked to Zoho CRM. Zoho Books has no bill of materials, so a manufacturer leaving Tally should compare Zoho ERP instead.
item.dc:creator: Arunkumar V

item.title: Zoho CRM vs HubSpot for Small Businesses: An Honest Comparison
item.description: Choose Zoho CRM if sales, operations and finance need to share customer data, you want to customize the system around your process and you want predictable per-user pricing. Choose HubSpot if marketing leads the business and you want website, email and CRM in one product. The biggest cost difference appears at HubSpot's Professional tier, which adds a higher seat price and a required onboarding fee.
item.dc:creator: Arunkumar V

item.title: Zoho MCP: How to Connect Claude or ChatGPT to Zoho CRM Safely
item.description: Zoho MCP lets an AI assistant such as Claude or ChatGPT use tools in your Zoho apps. Create a server in the Zoho MCP console, add only the tools you need, copy the MCP URL into your assistant and authorize with your Zoho account. Start with read-only tools, keep each user on their own authorization, and require confirmation before any change.
item.dc:creator: Arunkumar V

item.title: Zoho Flow vs Deluge vs Custom Middleware: Which to Use for an Integration
item.description: Use Zoho Flow for simple app-to-app automation with a few steps; it is metered by tasks, and each action in a flow counts as one. Use Deluge when the logic runs inside one Zoho app and must act at an exact point in a process. Use custom middleware for high volume, long-running jobs, retries or two-way sync.
item.dc:creator: Arunkumar V

item.title: Does Zoho Have Manufacturing Software? Zoho ERP, Inventory and Creator Compared
item.description: Zoho offers a manufacturer three routes. Zoho Inventory handles simple assembly but has no manufacturing module. Zoho ERP, launched in India in January 2026 and sold separately from Zoho One, has bills of materials, manufacturing orders, job cards, work centers, subcontracting and quality checks. Zoho Creator is for custom production apps built around your own process.
item.dc:creator: Arunkumar V

item.title: Zoho Creator vs Microsoft Power Apps: An Honest Comparison for Growing Businesses
item.description: Choose Zoho Creator if you already use Zoho apps and want the database, logic, portals and mobile apps in one product with per-user pricing. Choose Power Apps if your business runs on Microsoft 365 and your data already lives in SharePoint, Dataverse or SQL Server. The deciding factors are where your data lives, who uses the app and which licences each option needs.
item.dc:creator: Arunkumar V

item.title: Migrating from HubSpot or Salesforce to Zoho CRM: A Step-by-Step Plan
item.description: Map objects and fields first, create users and picklists in Zoho CRM, add a legacy ID field to every module, then import in order: accounts, contacts, leads, deals, activities and attachments. Automations do not migrate, so rebuild the ones you still need. A small, clean migration takes two to four weeks.
item.dc:creator: Arunkumar V

item.title: How Much Does a Zoho CRM Implementation Cost? A Transparent Breakdown
item.description: A Zoho CRM implementation typically takes 40 to 70 hours for a small starter setup, 100 to 180 hours for a standard rollout and 200 to 400 hours for an advanced multi-team project. Multiply the hours by a provider's rate to compare quotes, and add Zoho licence fees paid directly to Zoho.
item.dc:creator: Arunkumar V

item.title: Deluge Script Examples: 10 Real Automations for Zoho CRM, Creator and Books
item.description: Deluge is Zoho's scripting language for automating CRM, Creator, Books and other Zoho apps. The most useful scripts create invoices from won deals, flag duplicate records, create follow-up tasks, send scheduled reminders and call external APIs with invokeurl. All ten examples below are patterns from real projects.
item.dc:creator: Arunkumar V

item.title: Zoho Partner Program Explained: Authorized, Advanced and Premium Partners
item.description: A Zoho partner is a company in Zoho's official partner program, ranked in three tiers: Authorized, Advanced and Premium. Authorized partners have met a US$5,000 revenue threshold plus certification and project-success requirements; Advanced and Premium partners score above 400 and 600 points out of 1,000. Verify any partner in Zoho's Find a Partner directory.
item.dc:creator: Arunkumar V

item.title: AI Agents in Zoho CRM: What They Can Do Today and How to Prepare
item.description: AI in Zoho CRM is most useful today for summaries, drafting emails, data clean-up and prioritizing leads and deals. Actions involving money, customer commitments, deletions or key stage changes should stay rule-based or human-approved. Clean data, a defined process and clear permissions matter more than the AI model.
item.dc:creator: Arunkumar V

item.title: Getting Your Data Ready for AI in Zoho Analytics: A Practical Foundation
item.description: To get reliable dashboards and AI answers from Zoho Analytics, connect sources with native connectors, join tables on a shared customer ID, clean data where it is created, and define key metrics once as query tables. Only then rely on Ask Zia, and check its answers against a trusted report.
item.dc:creator: Arunkumar V

item.title: How to Choose a Zoho Development Partner or Developer: A Buyer’s Checklist
item.description: You do not need an official Zoho Partner to implement Zoho; you need relevant, demonstrable experience. Ask to see similar projects, who will do the work, how data migration and testing are handled, and what is documented. Keep the Zoho account in your own name and agree support after launch in writing.
item.dc:creator: Arunkumar V
